title: Adaptive Card: shift handover form for maintenance with aircraft reference and nothing-to-report toggle
summary: Adaptive Card 1.5 form for a written shift handover per aircraft or work order with validated shift and reference, a nothing-to-report toggle, open work, defects and parts, and Submit and Cancel.
body:
A written handover per aircraft or work order is easier to audit than a talk at the door. This card collects the fields that trade sources name for a maintenance handover: completed work, open work, new or closed defects, open parts or material and general problems. It also lets the team say 'nothing to report', because silence is not information. The regulatory basis and the required content belong in your maintenance organisation exposition (MOE) and procedures; check the current regulation and your MOE before you add or remove fields. The card is a convenience for the input; the record is stored in your system (a SharePoint list or your MRO software), not in the chat.

## Card JSON

```json
{
  "type": "AdaptiveCard",
  "$schema": "http://adaptivecards.io/schemas/adaptive-card.json",
  "version": "1.5",
  "msteams": {
    "width": "Full"
  },
  "body": [
    {
      "type": "TextBlock",
      "text": "Shift handover",
      "wrap": true,
      "size": "Large",
      "weight": "Bolder"
    },
    {
      "type": "TextBlock",
      "text": "One card per aircraft or work order. 'Nothing to report' is also a handover.",
      "wrap": true,
      "isSubtle": true,
      "spacing": "None"
    },
    {
      "type": "Input.ChoiceSet",
      "id": "shift",
      "label": "Shift that ends",
      "isRequired": true,
      "errorMessage": "Select the shift",
      "style": "compact",
      "value": "late",
      "choices": [
        {
          "title": "Early",
          "value": "early"
        },
        {
          "title": "Late",
          "value": "late"
        },
        {
          "title": "Night",
          "value": "night"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "Input.Text",
      "id": "workRef",
      "label": "Aircraft registration or work order",
      "isRequired": true,
      "errorMessage": "Enter the aircraft or order",
      "placeholder": "Example: D-ABCD or WO-10442",
      "maxLength": 40
    },
    {
      "type": "Input.Toggle",
      "id": "nothing",
      "title": "Nothing to report for this aircraft or order",
      "valueOn": "yes",
      "valueOff": "no",
      "value": "no",
      "wrap": true
    },
    {
      "type": "Input.Text",
      "id": "done",
      "label": "Work completed",
      "isMultiline": true,
      "maxLength": 1000
    },
    {
      "type": "Input.Text",
      "id": "open",
      "label": "Work still open, including next step",
      "isMultiline": true,
      "maxLength": 1000
    },
    {
      "type": "Input.Text",
      "id": "defects",
      "label": "New or closed defects (reference numbers)",
      "isMultiline": true,
      "maxLength": 500
    },
    {
      "type": "Input.Text",
      "id": "parts",
      "label": "Parts or material open",
      "isMultiline": true,
      "maxLength": 500
    },
    {
      "type": "Input.Text",
      "id": "issues",
      "label": "General problems (tools, access, safety, documents)",
      "isMultiline": true,
      "maxLength": 500
    },
    {
      "type": "TextBlock",
      "text": "This card does not replace task cards, the technical log or certifying staff decisions.",
      "wrap": true,
      "isSubtle": true,
      "size": "Small"
    }
  ],
  "actions": [
    {
      "type": "Action.Submit",
      "title": "Submit handover",
      "data": {
        "form": "shiftHandover",
        "version": 1
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "Action.Submit",
      "title": "Cancel",
      "data": {
        "form": "cancel"
      },
      "associatedInputs": "none"
    }
  ]
}
```

## How to use

1. Post the card with Power Automate (Teams 'Post adaptive card and wait for a response', or in a channel with the card posting action) or from a bot. For a form that many people fill, a bot or a Teams message extension is better than a flow that waits.
2. When the user presses Submit, read the inputs by id: shift, workRef, nothing, done, open, defects, parts, issues. Write one row to the 'Shift Handovers' list with a ShiftKey built from the date and the shift. Use the same key as your reminder flow.
3. Server side checks that a card cannot do: if nothing is 'no', at least one of done, open, defects, parts or issues must be filled; the aircraft reference must exist in your fleet or work order list. Return the same card with a red line if the check fails.
4. The Cancel button uses associatedInputs none, so it works with empty required fields.

## Worked example (invented data)

Late shift, 21:50. The team lead selects 'Late', enters 'WO-10442' (invented), writes 'Left main gear inspection task cards 3 to 7 done', 'Task card 8 open, waiting for torque wrench from calibration, next shift continues at card 8', and 'Defect reference DEF-2231 opened, parts ordered'. Parts: 'One seal kit open'. Submit creates one row. A second aircraft on the same line without findings gets its own card with the toggle set to yes. The reminder flow later finds two rows for the shift key and sees no missing team.

## Common mistakes

- Making all text fields required. People then write 'n/a' in each; use the toggle for a true empty handover.
- Free text without limits. Set maxLength so the record stays readable and the card within the message size.
- Trusting the card to enforce content rules. It only checks required fields and patterns on the client.
- Keeping the record in chat. A chat message can be edited or lost; store a row.
- Using the card output as a release or certification statement. It is a handover note only.

## Teams rendering limits and compatibility

- Teams rendering (Microsoft Learn cards reference, read 20 Nov 2026): bots and action-based message extensions support schema 1.6 or earlier, and the Teams mobile app up to 1.6; newer versions may render inconsistently. This card declares 1.5 on purpose, so it stays inside what older clients show.
- Adaptive Cards are not supported in tabs or connectors, and file or image uploads are not supported inside cards. Images must be PNG, JPEG or GIF up to 1024 x 1024 pixels, hosted at a public address without redirects; SVG and animated GIF are not supported.
- Design guidance from the same source: set wrap to true on text, avoid horizontal scrolling, use at most three columns per ColumnSet, give an explicit pixel width to at most one column and keep it small. Teams mobile does not scroll sideways.
- A card can have up to six actions, but one to three primary actions read best. The Learn page also lists positive and destructive action styling as not supported in some contexts, so the button titles must carry the meaning (check what your clients show).
- The whole message, including the card, is limited to about 28 KB (Teams connector page); keep cards small.
- Input.Toggle and multi-line Input.Text render in Teams desktop, web and mobile. Check long forms on a phone: keep the number of inputs small so the user does not scroll through a wall of fields.
- isRequired and errorMessage need schema 1.3 or higher; the card uses 1.5.

## Adapt it

Add a ChoiceSet with the handing-over team, a field for tooling and test equipment in use, or a link to the work package. Translate the labels into the working language of the hangar; keep the ids stable.

## Privacy and security

Handover text can name employees, customers and aircraft. Do not post it into channels with guests. Apply the same access rules as for the technical records, and agree with the works council and data protection officer who may read handover history. Never paste manual text or task card content into the free text fields; reference the document and revision.
